tells.1: none (clunky repetition like 'I had had' and the filler 'Anyway' read as an unpolished human draft, not AI)
tells.2: a slightly too-tidy 'Some lessons had gone beautifully. Others...' contrast
tells.3: colon-introduced triple list plus a semicolon-balanced antithesis give it a templated, polished cadence
tells.4: staccato three-part anaphora ('I straightened... I checked... I wiped') and a punchy fragment ending that feel deliberately 'humanized'
tells.5: 'I found myself doing' cliché, a colon list of gerunds, a semicolon antithesis and typographic curly apostrophes, the most machine-polished of the set

reason: Version 2 keeps the concrete, quietly observed details (the already-clean bench, the drive home) in plain, unforced sentences, without the stylized rhythm of 4 or the over-polished punctuation of 3 and 5. Version 1 is authentically human but too repetitive and vague to publish.
